subject: Re: Request for KMS/HSM key rotation telemetry and operator audit
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@foresite.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: security@foresite.com
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KMS/HSM: request for rotation telemetry + operator audit samples

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review for the onboarding window we need a scoped set of artifacts related to key management. To keep this focused, could you provide a 90-day sample (UTC timestamps preferred) containing: 

- Key rotation events (creation, rotation, retirement) with key IDs, timestamps, and rotation reason if recorded. CSV or JSON ok.
- HSM attestation statement (any cert/attestation PDF you have).
- Operator access audit: actions taken on KMS/HSM (operator principal, action, timestamp). Redaction of operator emails is acceptable if you can provide stable unique ids.
- Transport proofs: TLS cert chain & handshake logs for the KMS endpoint around a rotation event.
- A short excerpt (1-2 examples) of KV cache telemetry tied to encryption cache usage (prefix cache hits/misses, TTLs) to show caching strategy doesn't leak plaintext. Redact tenant identifiers as needed.

If you prefer, we accept redacted samples and a handful of synthetic examples that mirror the real format so long as the schema is identical. Please flag anything we should treat as restricted (PII/tenant ids). Can you confirm timeline to deliver these artifacts (or a partial delivery with the attestation first)?

Thanks — Jamie
Jamie Liu
Senior Security Engineer
Foresite Financial
[attachment: request_scope.pdf (stub)]
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@foresite.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM: request for rotation telemetry + operator audit samples

Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Assigning Jonah and Irene to pull the pieces, and I will own the delivery + packaging. High level plan:

- We will produce a 90-day rotation_export_90day.csv (redacted operator ids) and an HSM attestation PDF.
- KV cache excerpt: kv_cache_sample.json (redacted tenant ids).
- Transport/TLS chain: we can share the cert chain and a redacted handshake log for two rotation events.
- Operator audit: we can provide operator principal ids (alpha numeric), action verb, and truncated host/IP. Full email addresses will be redacted.

Questions: 
1) Do you want raw event timestamps in UTC or ISO8601 with timezone? We prefer ISO8601 with timezone offsets.
2) For operator audit, is a hashed operator_id acceptable if you supply the hashing seed for verification?

Tentative timeline: attestation PDF + rotation CSV by EOD 2026-08-15 (we can surface attestation earlier today if useful). Full package by 2026-08-17 if you need more samples. We will upload files to a restricted Drive folder and send presigned S3 links for large CSVs.

Attached is the current runbook excerpt so you can see the rotation metadata fields we will include.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Principal, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 720KB)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@foresite.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM: request for rotation telemetry + operator audit samples

Jamie — quick technical note on the artifacts we'll provide so there are no surprises:

- rotation_export_90day.csv: columns = [event_id, key_id, event_type, event_ts, previous_key_id, rotation_reason, initiated_by_id, request_id]. We will omit full principal emails; initiated_by_id will be a stable hashed id (sha256 truncated to 12 chars) unless you require the seed.
- hsm_attestation_2026.pdf: vendor-signed statement + HSM firmware/revision table.
- operator_audit.json (excerpt): { \"principal_id\": \"op-1a2b3c\", \"action\": \"generate_key\", \"ts\": \"2026-07-04T02:14:33Z\", \"source\": \"operator-console\" } (we will provide several similar lines).
- kv_cache_sample.json: will include prefix, hit/miss counters, TTL_seconds, and a redaction map for tenant->pseudonym.

We will also include an exported trace around one rotation with the TLS cert chain (server cert, intermediate) and a short tcpdump-level flow summary (no pcap attached). If you want us to include IAM change events for the operator principals (create/disable), say so and we can add that to the CSV.

We will provide a presigned S3 link (one-time, 48h) for the CSV and Drive links for PDFs.

— Jonas
Staff Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: hsm_attestation_2026.pdf (stub)]
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@foresite.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: security@foresite.com, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM: request for rotation telemetry + operator audit samples

Camila / team — perfect, that format works for us. A couple clarifications before you package: 

- ISO8601 with timezone is preferred.
- Hashed operator ids are acceptable; please include hashing algorithm and salt (or provide a verifiable seed to our security team). We will not request raw emails.
- We only need three rotation events fully populated (create/rotate/retire) as canary examples; the 90-day CSV can be the broader set.
- Please ensure any S3 presigned links are time-limited to 48 hours. Drive folder access should be restricted to security@foresite.com and jamie.liu@foresite.com.

If you can get the attestation PDF and the three canary rotation rows by EOD today (2026-08-15), that would be excellent. Otherwise EOD 2026-08-17 for the full package as you suggested is fine. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Best,
Jamie
Senior Security Engineer
Foresite Financial
